'''Verzon Tennd''' was [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] who took refuge for a night in [[Tosche Station/Legends|Tosche Station]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], along with his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2-D9]], during a particularly violent sandstorm.
